Subject: Pilot onboarding and invoice routing (CloudArc)

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team is excited to kick off the Q1 pilot. We have a short procurement ask: for speed-of-execution can CloudArc be onboarded on an invoice-only basis for the pilot (no PO), with Net30 payment terms? We will attach a signed SOW and the onboarding form.

If needed we can provide insurance cert + SOC2 summary. Pilot spend is expected to be ~ $8k–$10k over 6 weeks.

Attached: CloudArc_onboarding_form.xlsx; SOW_CloudArc_Q1.pdf

Please let me know the process and any evidence you need.

Best,
Natalie Ruiz
Head of Partnerships
CloudArc

Thanks Natalie — great to meet you.

We can consider a temporary invoice-only onboarding for pilots but need to run a short internal approval and attach a few guardrails so we don't create a recurring exception. At a high level we require:
- Signed SOW (received) and vendor onboarding form (received).
- Invoice with Net30 terms addressed to Redwood Inference AP.
- Invoice cap for the pilot (suggested: $15,000).
- Vendor to provide certificate of insurance and SOC2 summary (or equivalent).

Karthik (procurement) and Priyom (finance) — can you confirm if the above are sufficient for a Q1 pilot exception and what additional routing we should enforce?

If approved we'll route invoices to ap@redwood.ai and create a temporary vendor record with a 6-week expiry.

Grace O'Connor
Manager, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-01-17T16:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding and invoice routing (CloudArc)

Grace — thanks for the context and attachments. Quick notes from procurement:

- Procurement is comfortable with a time-limited invoice-only path for pilots if controls are in place. Proposed conditions:
  * Limit the exception to the pilot period (we'll set a vendor flag that expires 2028-03-01 unless extended).
  * Spend cap: $12,000 (procurement conservative cap; can flex to $15k with director approval).
  * Vendor must complete vendor onboarding form (done) and accept our standard T&Cs for pilots (we'll attach an addendum).
  * Invoices must be routed to ap@redwood.ai and include a PO placeholder text: "PO: temp-invoice-routing (no PO issued)" so our AP queues them correctly.
  * Risk: require SOC2 summary + COI before first invoice; procurement will do a light vendor risk check.

Laura / Markus — please confirm you approve the $12k conditional exception (or indicate if you want to allow up to $15k for GTM reasons). If approved, procurement will open the vendor record with the temporary flag and notify AP.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Procurement Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: ap@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-01-18T09:29:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding and invoice routing (CloudArc)

Adding AP and a couple of finance items:

- AP is okay to accept invoice-only for a short pilot provided the vendor is flagged as "temp-invoice" and invoices include the SOW reference and a single-line description of services.
- We need vendor tax paperwork (W-9 for US vendors; equivalent for non-US).
- Please request invoices route to ap@redwood.ai and cc: finance-ledger@redwood.ai so we have visibility.
- Suggest attachment: standard Invoice_Template.docx for vendor to follow our remit and line-item expectations.
- Please open a Jira (PROC-xxxx) to track the exception and approvals — we need an audit trail.

I'll approve up to $12,000 from finance; requests above that require Laura (director) sign-off.

Priyom Das
Finance Manager, Accounts Payable

Can you please confirm approval to allow up to $12k on this temporary path? If you want to allow up to $15k I can share rationale and expected GTM uplift.
